Array.description:
The array that a field belongs to. A figure lists the entries of an array
as fields numbered by their index and replaces the rows between them with
"...", for example LBAF0, LBAF1, "..." and LBAF63 of Identify Namespace.
Each listed entry has the array, with its own index.

name.description:
The name of the entries without the index, for example 'LBA Format
Support'
name.title: Name

acronym.description: The acronym of the entries without the index, for example 'LBAF'
acronym.title: Acronym

index.description:
The index of this entry, for example 63 for LBAF63; None for a last
entry whose range the figure gives as a formula
index.title: Index

first.description: The index of the first entry, 0 or 1 depending on the figure
first.title: First

count.description:
The number of entries, for example 64; None where the figure gives the
range of the last entry as a formula, because the number is then a value
in the data
count.title: Count

stride.description: The size of one entry, in the unit of the field
stride.title: Stride

lower.description: The offset of the first entry, which is where the array starts
lower.title: Lower

maximum.description:
The most entries the array holds, where it has no count and a
paragraph referring to its figure states it, as "up to 511 Zone
Identifier entries" of the Changed Zone List of ZNS 1.5
maximum.title: Maximum

Array.title: Array

Bits.description:
A field of bits or bytes, made with what it needs; 'upper' and 'lower'
are None where the document gives the range by a formula, or leaves it
open, as 'kind' says

name.description:
The name of the field, as 'Force Unit Access', or of the place it
holds, as 'Reserved'
name.title: Name

acronym.description:
Its acronym, as "FUA"; None where it has none or the document's is not
one, which is then an erratum
acronym.title: Acronym

upper.description: The upper bound of the range, inclusive
upper.title: Upper

lower.description: The lower bound of the range
lower.title: Lower

range.description: The range as the document writes it, as "29:26" or '03:00'
range.title: Range

description.description: The text of the field's description
description.title: Description

section.description:
The heading of a row of the figure that groups fields, as the fields
under it are of
section.title: Section

elided.description:
Whether the figure leaves rows out before it, as "..." between the
first and the last of entries counted by a value
elided.title: Elided

columns.description:
The figure's other columns of the field, by their keys, as "reset" or
'type'
columns.title: Columns

union.description: Of fields sharing bits, the union of the layout they are of
union.title: Union

alternative.description:
Of fields sharing bits, which fields go together, as an IPv4 address
and the reserved bits after it, against an IPv6 address of the same
bytes
alternative.title: Alternative

placements.description:
The range of the field under each condition heading the figure's
columns of ranges, where those differ; 'range' is the first that is
present
placements.title: Placements

byte_order.description:
The order of the field's bytes where the figure marks the byte of its
most significant bit (MSB) and that of its least (LSB), as the
protection information formats of the NVM Command Set do: "big-endian"
where the MSB is in the lowest byte. None where the figure does not mark
them, or the field is one byte
byte_order.title: Byte Order

footnotes.description: The numbers of the footnotes marked at the end of the description
footnotes.title: Footnotes

values.description:
The values the field takes, as the table in its description gives
them
values.title: Values

role.description:
What the field is: a "field" of its name, or what holds a place,
"reserved", "obsolete", "vendor_specific" or 'ignored'
role.title: Role

kind.description:
What the range is: a "span" of numbers, a "formula" of values the
figure names, as "(N*16)+15:N*16", or "open", as 'n/a' or 'Impl Spec'
kind.title: Kind

formula.description:
Of a formula, its bounds written plainly, "upper:lower", as
'16*N + 15:16*N'
formula.title: Formula

width.description:
How many bits or bytes the range is, where its bounds give it, as 16
of '16*N + 15:16*N'
width.title: Width

fields.description: The fields within this one, as its description lays them out
fields.title: Fields

values_in.description:
The source of the table of values of the field, where the description
of the field refers to that figure instead of listing the values, for
example "Refer to Figure 336". The table is the entry of the data model's
'values' with this source.

cases.description:
The cases of the field, where a table in its description gives the
meaning of the field for each value of another field of its figure
cases.title: Cases

array.description:
The array that the field belongs to, where the figure lists numbered
entries and leaves out the rows between them

structure.description:
The source of the structure that lays out the field. The description of
the field refers to the figure, for example "defined in Figure 125", or,
for an entry of an array, names the structure, for example "an I/O
Command Set Vector". The structure is the entry of the data model's
'structures' with this source.

Bits.title: Bits

Case.description:
The meaning of a field while another field of its figure has certain
values. For example, bits 15:08 of Zone Management Receive, ZRAS, are the
Reporting Options when ZRA is Report Zones or Extended Report Zones, and
are reserved for all other values of ZRA.

selector.description:
The controlling field: its acronym where the figure has a field of
the name that heads the table of cases, for example "ZRA" for 'Zone
Receive Action', and otherwise that name
selector.title: Selector

when.description:
The values of the controlling field that the case applies to; empty
for the case of all other values
when.title: When

otherwise.description:
Whether the case applies to every value of the controlling field that
no other case lists, as the row 'All other values' says
otherwise.title: Otherwise

name.description:
The name of the field in this case, for example "Reporting Options" or
"Reserved"; None where the figure gives no name
name.title: Name

acronym.description: The acronym of the field in this case, for example 'ZRWAA'
acronym.title: Acronym

description.description: The description of the field in this case
description.title: Description

values.description: The values of the field in this case
values.title: Values

role.description:
The role of the field in this case: a "field", or a placeholder such
as 'reserved'
role.title: Role

fields.description: The subfields of the field in this case
fields.title: Fields

Case.title: Case

Command.description: A command, by its opcode, with its dwords and its operations

name.description: The name of the command, as 'Write'
name.title: Name

sqe.description: The dwords of its submission queue entry that its figures lay out
sqe.title: Sqe

cqe.description: The dwords of its completion queue entry that its figures lay out
cqe.title: Cqe

operations.description: What it does for the values of its selecting fields, if it has any
operations.title: Operations

columns.description: The opcode table's other columns of the command, by their keys
columns.title: Columns

source.description: The opcode table listing the command

Command.title: Command

CommandSet.description: The commands of an opcode table, as Admin or NVM

name.description: The name of the command set
name.title: Name

commands.description: Its commands, by their names as keys, as 'zone_append'
commands.title: Commands

CommandSet.title: CommandSet

Diagnostic.description:
Something about a figure that senfd normalised, or could not make sense of

A 'note' is a variant senfd normalised; nothing is lost. A 'warning' is
something left out of the output, as a row whose range is not a range.

figure_nr.description: The number of the figure, where it is known
figure_nr.title: Figure Nr

code.description: What kind it is, as "figure-not-modelled" or 'dwords-unassigned'
code.title: Code

message.description: What was found, with the document and the figure, said for a person
message.title: Message

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

DocumentMeta.description: Who made the document and of what

format.description: The format of the data model, the shape its schema gives
format.title: Format

version.description: The version of senfd that made it
version.title: Version

senfd_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the source of the senfd that made it
senfd_sha256.title: Senfd Sha256

stem.description: The name of the document it is of, "merged" for the merged one
stem.title: Stem

file.description: The name of the file the document was made from, as given
file.title: File

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that file, by which a published document is known
sha256.title: Sha256

input_sha256.description: Of a merged data model, the SHA-256 of the documents it is made from
input_sha256.title: Input Sha256

combined_sha256.description:
Of a merged data model, the SHA-256 of input_sha256 and senfd_sha256
together, which the same documents read by the same senfd give again
combined_sha256.title: Combined Sha256

DocumentMeta.title: DocumentMeta

Dwords.description: The dwords 'lower' to 'upper' of a command, and their fields

lower.description: The first dword, as 10 of CDW10
lower.title: Lower

upper.description: The last dword, the same as 'lower' for one dword
upper.title: Upper

condition.description:
Where the figure lays the dwords out only under a condition, the
condition, as 'CETYPE is cleared to 0h'
condition.title: Condition

qualifier.description:
What the caption says the dwords are of, as 'NVM Command Set Specific
Fields'
qualifier.title: Qualifier

fields.description: The fields of the dwords, the bits counted across them
fields.title: Fields

Dwords.title: Dwords

Entry.description:
A row of a table of values, as a status value or a log page identifier;
'typed' has the values of its columns of a known kind as what they are

value.description: The value, as the document writes it, as '1Fh'
value.title: Value

value_column.description: The key of the column holding the value
value_column.title: Value Column

name.description: The name the row gives the value
name.title: Name

description.description: The text of the row's description
description.title: Description

columns.description: The row's other columns, by their keys
columns.title: Columns

typed.description: The values of the row's columns of a known kind, by their keys
typed.title: Typed

footnotes.description: The numbers of the footnotes marked at the end of the description
footnotes.title: Footnotes

refers_to.description:
The value of another field that the description names, where the entry
has no name of its own

Entry.title: Entry

Erratum.description:
Something of a figure that is not what its kind of value must be, as a
range beyond the dword it is of, left out of the model; or fields that do
not fit together, as two of the same bits, which the model keeps. Each is
a candidate erratum of the specification, saying where it is.

code.description:
What kind it is: "value", "acronym", "range" (text that is no range),
"range-outside", "range-reversed", "opcode", "gap" (of a command's
dwords), 'layout-gap' (of a structure) or "reference" (to the section of
another value)
code.title: Code

message.description: What is wrong, said for a person
message.title: Message

found.description: The text found in the figure
found.title: Found

Erratum.title: Erratum

Feature.description:
A feature, by its identifier, and the dwords of the commands setting and
getting it that are described for it

name.description: The name of the feature, as 'Number of Queues'
name.title: Name

columns.description:
The feature identifier table's other columns of it, by their keys, as
its requirements
columns.title: Columns

sqe.description: The submission queue entry dwords described for it
sqe.title: Sqe

cqe.description: The completion queue entry dwords described for it
cqe.title: Cqe

source.description: The feature identifier table listing it

Feature.title: Feature

LogPage.description: A log page, by its identifier, and the structure laying it out

identifier.description: The log page identifier, as 2 of 02h
identifier.title: Identifier

name.description: The name of the log page, as 'SMART / Health Information'
name.title: Name

columns.description: The log page identifier table's other columns of it, by their keys
columns.title: Columns

structure.description: The structure laying it out, where a figure is known for it

source.description: The log page identifier table listing it

LogPage.title: LogPage

Operation.description:
What a command does for the values of its selecting fields, as a directive
operation of Directive Receive by its directive type (DTYPE) and operation
(DOPER), with the dwords and the structures of that operation

selectors.description:
The values of the command's fields selecting it, by acronym, as
{"DTYPE": 0, "DOPER": 1}
selectors.title: Selectors

sqe.description: The submission queue entry dwords of the operation
sqe.title: Sqe

cqe.description: The completion queue entry dwords of the operation
cqe.title: Cqe

structures.description: The names of the structures the operation transfers
structures.title: Structures

Operation.title: Operation

Placement.description:
Where a field is while a condition heading the figure's columns of
ranges holds. For example, the PDU Header Digest of the TCP transport's
Command Capsule PDU is bytes 75:72 when HDGSTF=1 and not present when
HDGSTF=0.

condition.description: The condition as the figure writes it, for example 'HDGSTF=1'
condition.title: Condition

range.description:
The range under the condition as the figure writes it; None where the
figure says the field is not present
range.title: Range

upper.description: The upper bound of the range, inclusive; None where it is symbolic
upper.title: Upper

lower.description: The lower bound of the range
lower.title: Lower

Placement.title: Placement

Selected.description: A value of the controlling field that a case applies to

name.description:
The name of the value as the figure writes it, for example 'Report
Zones'
name.title: Name

value.description:
The value as a number, for example 0 for 00h; None where the
controlling field has no value of that name
value.title: Value

Selected.title: Selected

Source.description:
Where something came from: the document, the figure, the page the
figure is on, and the section it is in, by number and title

document.description:
The document, by the name of its file, as 'NVM Express Base
Specification, Revision 2-4 Ratified 2026-08-21'
document.title: Document

page_nr.description: The page the figure is on, by the document's table of figures
page_nr.title: Page Nr

pdf_page.description:
The page the figure is on in the PDF, counted from the file's first
page, where the document was read from a PDF; a link opens it there
pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

section.description: The number of the section the figure is in, as '3.1.4.1'
section.title: Section

Source.title: Source

Structure.description:
A layout of fields that is no command's dwords: a data structure, a log
page, a register or anything else a figure lays out

name.description: The name its caption gives, as 'CC - Controller Configuration'
name.title: Name

kind.description:
What its caption says it is, as "data_structure", "log_page" or
"register", or 'other'
kind.title: Kind

unit.description: What its fields' ranges count: "bits" or 'bytes'
unit.title: Unit

qualifier.description: What the caption says it is of, as 'Log Specific Field'
qualifier.title: Qualifier

offset.description: Of a register, its offset, as '14h'
offset.title: Offset

Structure.title: Structure

Typed.description:
A value of a table as what it is: a requirement "level" (M, O, P, NR, R),
a yes or no "flag", an "identifier" or a range of them, a "note" it is
given by, a "reference" to another specification, or "reserved",
"vendor_specific" or "not_applicable"; with the footnotes marked on it

lower.description: Of an identifier, it, or the first of a range
lower.title: Lower

upper.description: Of a range of identifiers, the last
upper.title: Upper

reference.description: Of a reference, the specification referred to
reference.title: Reference

footnotes.description: The numbers of the footnotes marked on the value
footnotes.title: Footnotes

Typed.title: Typed

ValueLink.description:
A value of a field of another figure that an entry's description names.
For example, Reporting Options 1h of Zone Management Receive, "List the
zones in the ZSE:Empty state.", names the zone state ZSE:Empty, which is
value 1h of the field ZS of the Zone Descriptor, ZNS 1.5 Figure 38.

field.description: The field by its acronym, or by its name where it has none, as 'ZS'
field.title: Field

value.description: The value as the figure writes it, as '1h'
value.title: Value

acronym.description: The acronym the description gives the value, as 'ZSE'
acronym.title: Acronym

ValueLink.title: ValueLink

Values.description:
A table of values, by the kind of its caption and what it names; the
scope is what the caption confines it to, as "I/O Commands"

kind.description:
What its caption says it is, as "status_values", "requirements" or
"log_page_identifiers", or 'other'
kind.title: Kind

name.description: What the caption names, as the command or field the values are of
name.title: Name

qualifier.description: What else the caption says they are of
qualifier.title: Qualifier

scope.description: What the caption confines them to, as 'I/O Commands'
scope.title: Scope

Values.title: Values

description:
The data model of the specification, of one document or, merged, of
several

meta.description: The version of senfd that made the document, and what it is of

command_sets.description: The command sets of the opcode tables, by their names as keys
command_sets.title: Command Sets

dwords.description: The dwords of every figure, by the name its caption gives, as read
dwords.title: Dwords

structures.description: Every layout that is no command's dwords
structures.title: Structures

features.description: The features, by their names as keys
features.title: Features

log_pages.description: The log pages, by their names as keys
log_pages.title: Log Pages

unassigned.description:
The dwords no command, feature or operation claims, by the name their
caption gives
unassigned.title: Unassigned

diagnostics.description: What senfd normalised, or could not read as data
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

errata.description: The candidate errata of the documents
errata.title: Errata

sections.description:
The title of each numbered section, by its number as printed, of each
document by its name
sections.title: Sections

documents.description:
The documents the data model is of, by name, each with the file it
was made from and the file's SHA-256, by which a published one is known
documents.title: Documents

title: SpecDocument
